keyFindings.description: Stale comment: it says the changed answer's row stores selected as null, but since c30217fe new answers store []. Wording only (on the Fast-follow line).
The doc says the source is never cut before the parse, but SearchPalette now cuts it with markdownHead; the markdown-fragment.ts header covers only server cuts. Wording only (Fast-follow).
The unit test pins the exact suffix that the 280-character cut produces, and AGENTS.md and the e2e comment repeat 280. Test brittleness only; the user-visible bound is also asserted (Fast-follow).
Hardening, no exploit path: indentedText splits on \r?\n only, so a lone CR or U+2028/U+2029 in a resolution reason is not indented. The excerpt already carries agent-written text.

Adjacent and pre-existing: the event log and live stream send stored ask.answered payloads raw, so an old event with selected null still reads null there (web EventBody.tsx:53 previous.selected.join would throw on an old previous_answer). This PR's CHANGELOG names only the ask routes, which is accurate; recorded in the PR body's Not proven / risk and sent to the architect.

roundOneFindings: All three fixed in b9278db5: indentedText for the resolution reason (search-answer.ts:33,49, test with CRLF); markdownHead(answer.text, 280) before MarkdownPreview (SearchPalette.tsx), with e2e asserting the accessible name stays under 600 characters and lacks the answer's tail word; envoy-plugin CHANGELOG entry. The architect's selected-null fix landed in c30217fe (AskAnswer.UnmarshalJSON plus [] stored on write, ask_selected_test.go). Threads PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6wkC-G, -L, -T replied on and accepted; the implementer resolved all three.
